Daane agle 28 second mein shuruati phatne ki dar se chaar guna badh jate hain, lekin aakhri 28 second mein, phatna pichle 28 second ki dar ka aadha ho jata hai. Jab Anita patila ko garmi se hata leta hai, pakane ke aakhri 28 second mein jitne daane phat the, us sankhya ka chautha hissa bhi bacha hua garmi se phat jata hai. Anita ko khane ke liye kitne phatke milte hain?
synthetic.answer:
Pakane ke dusre 28 second mein, 3*80=<<3*80=240>>240 daana phat jate hain.
Tisre 28 second mein, 4*80=<<4*80=320>>320 daana phat jate hain.
Aakhri 28 second mein, 320 / 2 = <<320/2=160>>160 daana phat jate hain.
Pakane ke baad, bacha hua garmi 160 / 4 = <<160/4=40>>40 daana phat jate hain.
Isliye, Anita ke paas 80 + 240 + 320 + 160 + 40 = <<80+240+320+160+40=840>>840 khane ke liye phatke hain.
